**Release pipeline next steps** (not in this commit): (1) push `dev` to origin (already done for prior commits; will need re-push for this one); (2) FF `main` to `dev` (already at `cfbc500`; will need re-FF for this bump); (3) cut RC tag `v2.7.0-rc1` — triggers Workflow B → TestPyPI publish + matrix smoke; (4) dispatch Workflow C with the RC version + Workflow B run ID → approval-gated PyPI publish + **first real-world exercise of the v2.6.1 CDN-poll fix**. If the poll surfaces the new version in ≤2 attempts, fix landed correctly; if it exhausts (8 attempts × 15s = 120s max), we discover a CDN-lag failure mode not observed at protocol design time.

**Verification**: test suite unchanged from Commit K exit (enterprise 269 pass + 1 skip, base 770 pass + 2 pre-existing xfails). Zero regressions. `pyproject.toml` version bump is byte-simple; wheel build not exercised locally (Workflow B's job).

**Significance-check assessment** (constitution step 7): SIGNIFICANT — release commit. `change-type: release`, `significance: architectural` because this release completes Phase 2 of the ratified Enterprise audit-surface tranche AND establishes the first fully-shipped end-to-end audit-question surface for the transcripts-first architecture. Steelman argument against v2.7.0 (in favor of v2.6.2 PATCH): the changes are all additive so PATCH could be argued semantically. Response: PATCH is for backwards-compatible bug fixes only under strict semver; new features (even backwards-compatible ones) require MINOR. Three new user-facing verbs + three new user-facing endpoints are unambiguously new-feature surface. MINOR (v2.7.0) is honest. Steelman for v3.0.0 MAJOR: the audit-surface tranche establishes a materially new user-facing capability. Response: v3.0.0 is reserved for the point when the Enterprise-cli single-pipx install ships + the audit surface widens to Codex + Gemini (Phase 3+4+5 completion). v2.7.0 is the intermediate step where Claude-first audit is evaluator-ready.

**Post-v2.7.0 outlook**: Phase 3 (Enterprise-side Codex adapter) is the natural next tranche per parent plan §5. Blocked only on Architect firing. §10 items 1-7 in the audit-surface parent plan remain phase-kickoff-deferrable. Item 8 (declared-evidence surface) stays specification-only unless Phase 3+4 exit reveals it's needed.
